_source.description: Thermal conductivity (isotropic, near room temperature ~20-25 C) for the steady-state heat-conduction FEA solver (core/sim/fea_thermal). Keyed by the same sim keys as engine_oracle/sim/materials.json. Values are room-temperature engineering references; conductivity varies with temperature and (for metals) with alloy temper, so these are defaults a user can override per study.
references: Incropera, DeWitt, Bergman & Lavine, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 6th ed., Table A.1 (metals) / A.3 (nonmetals).
ASM International, ASM Handbook Vol. 2, Properties and Selection: Nonferrous Alloys (Al/Cu/Ti/Mg alloy conductivities).
MatWeb material property datasheets (polymers: ABS/PLA/PETG/Nylon/PC/PEEK/PMMA — manufacturer typical values).
Engineering Toolbox, Thermal Conductivity of common Materials (concrete, glass, lead cross-check).
_source.note: Provenance table for T-SIM1. Kept separate from materials.json because that file is a generated mirror guarded by test_export_sim_json; adding fields there would break the mirror contract. The FEA study reads material.k_w_mk; this table supplies the cited default.
